title: Butterfly Lovers
synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.

fullText.simplified:
周小英想了想，说：“我进来的时候你们不是没认出我吗？就像妈妈说的一样，我是你们的女儿，所以我穿什么衣服，你们都能认出来。但是不认识我的人，不知道我是女孩子，我穿着男孩子的衣服，他们不会觉得我是女孩子的。”
    周爸爸周妈妈觉得小英说得也对。再说，周爸爸不想小英因为这件事，真的生病了。
    所以周爸爸说：“好！爸爸妈妈让你去学校！”
    小英听到后，高兴地跳了起来：“谢谢爸爸妈妈！你们最好了！我最爱你们了！”
    “但是，你要做到这三点：第一，不能进男孩子的房间；第二，不能让男孩子进你的房间；第三，爸爸妈妈给你三年的时间读书。三年后你就要回家来。你能做到这三点吗？”周妈妈问。
    “能，能！”小英太高兴了，“你们给我去学校，别说这三点了，就是有十点、一百点，我都能做到！”
    周爸爸周妈妈看到女儿那么高兴，也觉得很高兴。
    周妈妈帮小英做了几件男孩子的衣服，给了她很多钱，还让下人小七和她一起去学校。小七也是女孩子，所以周妈妈让下人给小七也做了几件男孩子的衣服。
    小英和小七穿上男孩子的衣服，上学去了。她们一路上跑啊，跳啊，高兴得不得了。
百书学校很远。那个时候没有车，她们走路去学校要走三天。在路上，她们认识了一个人，名叫大山，他也要去百书学校读书。小英很高兴她还没有去到学校就认识了新同学。
    因为小英十六岁，大山十七岁，所以小英叫大山做“哥哥”，大山叫小英做“弟弟”。一路上小英和大山说这说那，他们有说不完的话。虽然去学校的路很远，但是他们一点儿都不觉得累。就这样，小英、大山和小七一起到了百书学校。
fullText.traditional:
周小英想了想，說：“我進來的時候你們不是沒認出我嗎？就像媽媽說的一樣，我是你們的女兒，所以我穿什麼衣服，你們都能認出來。但是不認識我的人，不知道我是女孩子，我穿著男孩子的衣服，他們不會覺得我是女孩子的。”
    周爸爸周媽媽覺得小英說得也對。再說，周爸爸不想小英因為這件事，真的生病了。
    所以周爸爸說：“好！爸爸媽媽讓你去學校！”
    小英聽到後，高興地跳了起來：“謝謝爸爸媽媽！你們最好了！我最愛你們了！”
    “但是，你要做到這三點：第一，不能進男孩子的房間；第二，不能讓男孩子進你的房間；第三，爸爸媽媽給你三年的時間讀書。三年後你就要回家來。你能做到這三點嗎？”周媽媽問。
    “能，能！”小英太高興了，“你們給我去學校，別說這三點了，就是有十點、一百點，我都能做到！”
    周爸爸周媽媽看到女兒那麼高興，也覺得很高興。
    周媽媽幫小英做了幾件男孩子的衣服，給了她很多錢，還讓下人小七和她一起去學校。小七也是女孩子，所以周媽媽讓下人給小七也做了幾件男孩子的衣服。
    小英和小七穿上男孩子的衣服，上學去了。她們一路上跑啊，跳啊，高興得不得了。
百書學校很遠。那個時候沒有車，她們走路去學校要走三天。在路上，她們認識了一個人，名叫大山，他也要去百書學校讀書。小英很高興她還沒有去到學校就認識了新同學。
    因為小英十六歲，大山十七歲，所以小英叫大山做“哥哥”，大山叫小英做“弟弟”。一路上小英和大山說這說那，他們有說不完的話。雖然去學校的路很遠，但是他們一點兒都不覺得累。就這樣，小英、大山和小七一起到了百書學校。

sentences.traditional: 周小英想了想，說：
sentences.pinyin: zhōu xiǎo yīng xiǎng le xiǎng shuō

sentences.simplified: “我进来的时候你们不是没认出我吗？
sentences.traditional: “我進來的時候你們不是沒認出我嗎？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jìn lái de shí hou nǐ men bú shì méi rèn chū wǒ ma
sentences.english: “You didn't recognize that it was me when I came in, right?”

sentences.simplified: 就像妈妈说的一样，我是你们的女儿，所以我穿什么衣服，你们都能认出来。
sentences.traditional: 就像媽媽說的一樣，我是你們的女兒，所以我穿什麼衣服，你們都能認出來。
sentences.pinyin: jiù xiàng mā ma shuō de yí yàng wǒ shì nǐ men de nǚ ér suǒ yǐ wǒ chuān shén me yī fu nǐ men dōu néng rèn chū lái
sentences.english: “Just like Mother said, I’m your daughter, so whatever clothes I wear, you’ll always be able to recognize me.”

sentences.simplified: 但是不认识我的人，不知道我是女孩子，我穿着男孩子的衣服，他们不会觉得我是女孩子的。”
sentences.traditional: 但是不認識我的人，不知道我是女孩子，我穿著男孩子的衣服，他們不會覺得我是女孩子的。”
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì bú rèn shi wǒ de rén bù zhī dào wǒ shì nǚ hái zi wǒ chuān zhe nán hái zi de yī fu tā men bú huì jué de wǒ shì nǚ hái zi de
sentences.english: “But people that don’t know me, and don’t know I'm a girl, if I wear boy’s clothes, they won’t think that I’m a girl.”

sentences.simplified: 周爸爸周妈妈觉得小英说得也对。
sentences.traditional: 周爸爸周媽媽覺得小英說得也對。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu bà ba zhōu mā ma jué de xiǎo yīng shuō de yě duì
sentences.english: Father Zhou and Mother Zhou thought that what Xiao Ying said was right.

sentences.simplified: 再说，周爸爸不想小英因为这件事，真的生病了。
sentences.traditional: 再說，周爸爸不想小英因為這件事，真的生病了。
sentences.pinyin: zài shuō zhōu bà ba bù xiǎng xiǎo yīng yīn wèi zhè jiàn shì zhēn de shēng bìng le
sentences.english: What’s more, Father Zhou didn’t want Xiao Ying to really fall ill from this thing.

sentences.simplified: 所以周爸爸说：“好！爸爸妈妈让你去学校！”
sentences.traditional: 所以周爸爸說：“好！爸爸媽媽讓你去學校！”
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ zhōu bà ba shuō hǎo bà ba mā ma ràng nǐ qù xué xiào
sentences.english: Therefore Father Zhou said: “Fine! Your Father and Mother will let you go to school!”

sentences.simplified: 小英听到后，高兴地跳了起来：
sentences.traditional: 小英聽到後，高興地跳了起來：
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng tīng dào hòu gāo xìng de tiào le qǐ lái
sentences.english: After Xiao Ying heard this, she started jumping happily:

sentences.simplified: “谢谢爸爸妈妈！你们最好了！我最爱你们了！”
sentences.traditional: “謝謝爸爸媽媽！你們最好了！我最愛你們了！”
sentences.pinyin: xiè xie bà ba mā ma nǐ men zuì hǎo le wǒ zuì ài nǐ men le
sentences.english: “Thank you, Father and Mother! You’re the best! I love you the most!”

sentences.simplified: “但是，你要做到这三点：第一，不能进男孩子的房间；
sentences.traditional: “但是，你要做到這三點：第一，不能進男孩子的房間；
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì nǐ yào zuò dào zhè sān diǎn dì yī bù néng jìn nán hái zi de fáng jiān
sentences.english: “But, you have to do these three things: Number 1, you can’t go into a boy’s room;”

sentences.simplified: 第二，不能让男孩子进你的房间；
sentences.traditional: 第二，不能讓男孩子進你的房間；
sentences.pinyin: dì èr bù néng ràng nán hái zi jìn nǐ de fáng jiān
sentences.english: “Number 2, you can’t let boys into your room;”

sentences.simplified: 第三，爸爸妈妈给你三年的时间读书。三年后你就要回家来。
sentences.traditional: 第三，爸爸媽媽給你三年的時間讀書。三年後你就要回家來。
sentences.pinyin: dì sān bà ba mā ma gěi nǐ sān nián de shí jiān dú shū sān nián hòu nǐ jiù yào huí jiā lái
sentences.english: “Number 3, Father and Mother give you three years' time to study. After three years you have to come back home.”

sentences.simplified: 你能做到这三点吗？”周妈妈问。
sentences.traditional: 你能做到這三點嗎？”周媽媽問。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ néng zuò dào zhè sān diǎn ma zhōu mā ma wèn
sentences.english: “Can you do these three things?” Mother Zhou asked.

sentences.simplified: “能，能！”小英太高兴了，
sentences.traditional: “能，能！”小英太高興了，
sentences.pinyin: néng néng xiǎo yīng tài gāo xìng le
sentences.english: “Yes, I can!” Xiao Ying got very happy.

sentences.simplified: “你们给我去学校，别说这三点了，就是有十点、一百点，我都能做到！”
sentences.traditional: “你們給我去學校，別說這三點了，就是有十點、一百點，我都能做到！”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ men gěi wǒ qù xué xiào bié shuō zhè sān diǎn le jiù shì yǒu shí diǎn yì bǎi diǎn wǒ dōu néng zuò dào
sentences.english: “If you let me go to school, not only these three things, I could do ten things or even a hundred things!”

sentences.simplified: 周爸爸周妈妈看到女儿那么高兴，也觉得很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 周爸爸周媽媽看到女兒那麼高興，也覺得很高興。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu bà ba zhōu mā ma kàn dào nǚ ér nà me gāo xìng yě jué de hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: Father Zhou and Mother Zhou saw how happy their daughter got, and also felt very happy.

sentences.simplified: 周妈妈帮小英做了几件男孩子的衣服，给了她很多钱，
sentences.traditional: 周媽媽幫小英做了幾件男孩子的衣服，給了她很多錢，
sentences.pinyin: zhōu mā ma bāng xiǎo yīng zuò le jǐ jiàn nán hái zi de yī fu gěi le tā hěn duō qián
sentences.english: Mother Zhou helped Xiao Ying make a few boy’s clothes, and gave her a lot of money.

sentences.simplified: 还让下人小七和她一起去学校。
sentences.traditional: 還讓下人小七和她一起去學校。
sentences.pinyin: hái ràng xià rén xiǎo qī hé tā yì qǐ qù xué xiào
sentences.english: They also had the servant Xiao Qi go to school together with her.

sentences.simplified: 小七也是女孩子，所以周妈妈让下人给小七也做了几件男孩子的衣服。
sentences.traditional: 小七也是女孩子，所以周媽媽讓下人給小七也做了幾件男孩子的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo qī yě shì nǚ hái zi suǒ yǐ zhōu mā ma ràng xià rén gěi xiǎo qī yě zuò le jǐ jiàn nán hái zi de yī fu
sentences.english: Xiao Qi was also a girl, so Mother Zhou had a servant make some boy’s clothes for Xiao Qi as well.

sentences.simplified: 小英和小七穿上男孩子的衣服，上学去了。
sentences.traditional: 小英和小七穿上男孩子的衣服，上學去了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng hé xiǎo qī chuān shang nán hái zi de yī fu shàng xué qù le
sentences.english: Xiao Ying and Xiao Qi put on the boy’s clothes and went to attend school.

sentences.simplified: 她们一路上跑啊，跳啊，高兴得不得了。
sentences.traditional: 她們一路上跑啊，跳啊，高興得不得了。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yí lù shang pǎo a tiào a gāo xìng de bù dé liǎo
sentences.english: They ran and skipped all the way, and were extremely happy.

sentences.simplified: 百书学校很远。
sentences.traditional: 百書學校很遠。
sentences.pinyin: bǎi shū xué xiào hěn yuǎn
sentences.english: The School of a Hundred Books was very far away.

sentences.simplified: 那个时候没有车，她们走路去学校要走三天。
sentences.traditional: 那個時候沒有車，她們走路去學校要走三天。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge shí hou méi yǒu chē tā men zǒu lù qù xué xiào yào zǒu sān tiān
sentences.english: At that time there were no cars, so they had to walk for three days to get to school.

sentences.simplified: 在路上，她们认识了一个人，名叫大山，
sentences.traditional: 在路上，她們認識了一個人，名叫大山，
sentences.pinyin: zài lù shang tā men rèn shi le yí ge rén míng jiào dà shān
sentences.english: On the road, they got to know someone named Dashan.

sentences.simplified: 他也要去百书学校读书。
sentences.traditional: 他也要去百書學校讀書。
sentences.pinyin: tā yě yào qù bǎi shū xué xiào dú shū
sentences.english: He was also going to the School of a Hundred Books to study.

sentences.simplified: 小英很高兴她还没有去到学校就认识了新同学。
sentences.traditional: 小英很高興她還沒有去到學校就認識了新同學。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng hěn gāo xìng tā hái méi yǒu qù dào xué xiào jiù rèn shi le xīn tóng xué
sentences.english: Xiao Ying was very happy that she got to know a new classmate before even reaching the School of a Hundred Books.

sentences.simplified: 因为小英十六岁，大山十七岁，
sentences.traditional: 因為小英十六歲，大山十七歲，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi xiǎo yīng shí liù suì dà shān shí qī suì
sentences.english: Because Xiao Ying was 16 years old, and Dashan 17 years old, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以小英叫大山做“哥哥”，大山叫小英做“弟弟”。
sentences.traditional: 所以小英叫大山做“哥哥”，大山叫小英做“弟弟”。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ xiǎo yīng jiào dà shān zuò gē ge dà shān jiào xiǎo yīng zuò dì di
sentences.english: .. Xiao Ying called Dashan “big brother”, and Dashan called Xiao Ying “little brother”.

sentences.simplified: 一路上小英和大山说这说那，他们有说不完的话。
sentences.traditional: 一路上小英和大山說這說那，他們有說不完的話。
sentences.pinyin: yí lù shang xiǎo yīng hé dà shān shuō zhè shuō nà tā men yǒu shuō bù wán de huà
sentences.english: The whole journey Xiao Ying and Dashan talked about this and that, and didn’t run out of things to say.

sentences.simplified: 虽然去学校的路很远，但是他们一点儿都不觉得累。
sentences.traditional: 雖然去學校的路很遠，但是他們一點兒都不覺得累。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán qù xué xiào de lù hěn yuǎn dàn shì tā men yì diǎn'r dōu bù jué de lèi
sentences.english: Although the way to school was very far, they still didn’t feel even the least bit tired.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，小英、大山和小七一起到了百书学校。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，小英、大山和小七一起到了百書學校。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng xiǎo yīng dà shān hé xiǎo qī yì qǐ dào le bǎi shū xué xiào
sentences.english: In this way, Xiao Ying, Dashan, and Xiao Qi arrived together at the School of a Hundred Books.

raw.synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.
sentence_translations: Zhou Xiao Ying thought about it and said:
“You didn't recognize that it was me when I came in, right?”
“Just like Mother said, I’m your daughter, so whatever clothes I wear, you’ll always be able to recognize me.”
“But people that don’t know me, and don’t know I'm a girl, if I wear boy’s clothes, they won’t think that I’m a girl.”
Father Zhou and Mother Zhou thought that what Xiao Ying said was right.
What’s more, Father Zhou didn’t want Xiao Ying to really fall ill from this thing.
Therefore Father Zhou said: “Fine! Your Father and Mother will let you go to school!”
After Xiao Ying heard this, she started jumping happily:
“Thank you, Father and Mother! You’re the best! I love you the most!”
“But, you have to do these three things: Number 1, you can’t go into a boy’s room;”
“Number 2, you can’t let boys into your room;”
“Number 3, Father and Mother give you three years' time to study. After three years you have to come back home.”
“Can you do these three things?” Mother Zhou asked.
“Yes, I can!” Xiao Ying got very happy.
“If you let me go to school, not only these three things, I could do ten things or even a hundred things!”
Father Zhou and Mother Zhou saw how happy their daughter got, and also felt very happy.
Mother Zhou helped Xiao Ying make a few boy’s clothes, and gave her a lot of money.
They also had the servant Xiao Qi go to school together with her.
Xiao Qi was also a girl, so Mother Zhou had a servant make some boy’s clothes for Xiao Qi as well.
Xiao Ying and Xiao Qi put on the boy’s clothes and went to attend school.
They ran and skipped all the way, and were extremely happy.
The School of a Hundred Books was very far away.
At that time there were no cars, so they had to walk for three days to get to school.
On the road, they got to know someone named Dashan.
He was also going to the School of a Hundred Books to study.
Xiao Ying was very happy that she got to know a new classmate before even reaching the School of a Hundred Books.
Because Xiao Ying was 16 years old, and Dashan 17 years old, ..
.. Xiao Ying called Dashan “big brother”, and Dashan called Xiao Ying “little brother”.
The whole journey Xiao Ying and Dashan talked about this and that, and didn’t run out of things to say.
Although the way to school was very far, they still didn’t feel even the least bit tired.
In this way, Xiao Ying, Dashan, and Xiao Qi arrived together at the School of a Hundred Books.
